desc:
🟢 Why is this house FULL OF SLIME?!

Your job is simple: EAT YOUR WAY OUT. 🥄
Don’t ask questions. Just keep scooping.

🥄 Eat through massive rooms of jelly
🚽 Fill your belly, then flush for coins
💪 Upgrade your tools & stomach
💎 Discover treasures buried in the slime
👥 Play solo or team up with up to 4 players
🏠 Escape house after house...

A 1–4 player co-op incremental adventure all about eating slime, buying upgrades, and escaping together.

What’s buried in the next room? Grab a spoon and find out. 👀
